question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Feast one’s eyes on
solution:
The correct answer is '**Gaze at something with pleasure**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Feast one's eyes on is an idiom that means **to look at someone or something with great enjoyment**.(किसी को या किसी चीज को बड़े मजे से देखना)

 
 
• ​Example - *We walked through the valley, **feasting our eyes on** the beauty all around us.​ *
 
 
 
• So, gaze at something with pleasure is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.(किसी चीज को खुशी से देखना दिए गए मुहावरे का सबसे उपयुक्त अर्थ है।)
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
